name: 💀 Steal An EXE Egg! 💀
desc:
☠️ Steal An EXE Egg... then RUN!

How to Play:

🥚 Sneak into monster territories at night and steal an EXE Egg.
🥷 Escape the monster chase and bring the egg safely back to your plot.
🐣 Wait for your egg to hatch and discover a powerful EXE monster.
💰 Place your EXEs on your plot to earn cash.
🏃 Train to increase your speed and escape stronger monsters.
🏠 Upgrade your training and expand your plot.
🌎 Unlock new areas filled with scarier monsters and rarer EXE Eggs.
✨ Discover rare eggs, huge pets, and special mutations.

🎮 Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet.

Like the game & Join the Group for +10K Speed!
